title: Will this API change break the mobile app?
checks: Every breaking change is found, and nothing else

breaking_changes(OLD, NEW) == sorted([
 "GET /claims/{id}: response field 'status' type changed from string to integer",
 "GET /claims/{id}: response field 'updated' removed",
 "GET /policies/{id}: endpoint removed",
 "POST /claims: new required request field 'channel'",
 "POST /claims: request field 'amount' type changed from number to string"])
Identical contracts have no breaking changes
Additions alone are not breaking, changes are

breaking_changes({'GET /a': {'request': {}, 'response': {'x': {'type': 'string'}}}}, {'GET /a': {'request': {'y': {'type': 'string', 'required': False}}, 'response': {'x': {'type': 'string'}, 'z': {'type': 'integer'}}}}) == [] and breaking_changes({'GET /a': {'request': {}, 'response': {'x': {'type': 'string'}}}}, {'GET /a': {'request': {}, 'response': {'x': {'type': 'integer'}}}}) == ["GET /a: response field 'x' type changed from string to integer"]
len(breaking_changes(OLD, NEW)) > 1 and breaking_changes(OLD, NEW) == sorted(breaking_changes(OLD, NEW))
